per_plume.source_hint: diffuse SW veil with no confirmed vent or fire source
evidence: USGS HVO at image time reports Kilauea ADVISORY/YELLOW in episodic_pause after episode 55 ended Oct 17 with next fountaining forecast Oct 30-Nov 5, and Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN not erupting, so no active eruptive vog source. [E1]
10-m wind at veil centroid from 24 deg at 22.1 km/h blows toward ~204 deg (SSW), which is consistent with location of broad veil southwest of Hawaii island but does not identify source. [E2]
No FIRMS fire clusters and no summit volcanic_thermal pixels on 2026-10-25 in Hawaii box, arguing against wildfire_smoke and against active summit lava/strong thermal. [E3]

Geometry is huge and diffuse at 119868 km2 and 672 km long with wind-based upwind end 223.9 km from Kilauea and 206.8 km from Mauna Loa, and mask has land_spill true swallowing Maui and Molokai, indicating unanchored unreliable segmentation mixing island cloud. [E6, E4]

Measured 3-h drift toward 328 deg NNW at 14.9 km/h with fit R2 0.66 disagrees by ~124 deg with wind-implied motion toward ~204 deg SSW, and inferred source end is 87.2 km from Kilauea and 63.0 km from Mauna Loa not at vents, undermining a simple vog-trailing story. [E5, E2]

classify.caveats: Kilauea was in episodic pause so residual degassing cannot be fully excluded; only 10-m wind used so high-cloud motion may differ; mask is very large/diffuse and swallows islands making geometry unreliable; motion-wind disagreement lowers confidence in any transport story.

kilauea.activity_summary: The Halema'uma'u eruption of Kīlauea is currently paused after episode 55 fountaining ended on October 17. Summit reinflation continues today and the forecast for episode 56 fountaining is between October 30 and November 5, 2026. Overview: The summit eruption of Kīlauea in Halemaʻumaʻu is paused following lava fountaining in episode 55 on October 17, 2026.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
